title: Kuroko's Basketball: The Greatest Present
native: 黒子のバスケ ~最高のプレゼントです~
synopsis:
A few weeks after the Winter Cup, the five players of the Generation of Miracles as well as Kuroko have settled back into everyday life. But an invitation from Momoi arrives, proposing that the former Teikou Junior High players gather once again and play a game.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
